svg.title: BegaIA Operating Model — View C — INTERNAL
svg.desc: Derived, non-contractual authority and capability boundary view. Seven persistent roles have scoped authority, technical capabilities, explicit restrictions and conditional authority dependencies. Gates validate eligibility without executing actions. Git write and reserved manual actions remain protected Human Authority actions. The composition is relational and does not encode temporal order.

g.aria-label: Title, thesis and provenance
g.text: BegaIA Operating Model — View C — INTERNAL
El Operating Model distribuye capacidades especializadas y autoridad acotada por ámbito;
los gates validan sin ejecutar, y las acciones protegidas permanecen bajo Human Authority.

g.aria-label: Representation metadata
Semantic center: distinctions between authority, capability, permission and responsibility
g.text: Responsibility names an accountable domain; View A carries the fuller role-responsibility view.

g.aria-label: Permission is the intersection of affordance, role capability, contextual permission and satisfied gates
g.text: technical affordance ∩ role capability ∩ contextual permission ∩ satisfied gates = action allowed
Agent capability or sandbox approval ≠ permission to perform Human-Authority-only actions

g.aria-label: Operating Model System authority and capability zoom
g.text: OPERATING MODEL SYSTEM · AUTHORITY / CAPABILITY ZOOM

g.aria-label: Human Authority protected zone
Git write is a Human Authority only protected action
Reserved manual actions and operational accountability

g.text: No agent execution path crosses this boundary.

g.aria-label: Six specialized role cards alongside Human Authority
AGPT / Orchestration scoped authority and capabilities
g.text: hito definition · dispatch · contextual authorization · output coordination

g.aria-label: System Architect scoped structural decision authority and capabilities
g.text: MAY DECIDE · scoped cross-slice dictámenes / structural roadmap state

g.aria-label: KB Architect recommendation authority and capabilities
g.text: cross-slice impact → System Architect authority required
KB recommendation authority ≠ cross-slice decision authority

g.aria-label: Technical Implementer capabilities and contextual permission boundary
g.text: structural ambiguity / cross-slice risk → System Architect authority required
repository modification capability ≠ Git write authority
does not redefine scope or architecture

g.aria-label: Repo Guardian audit gate authority and capabilities
HDOC evidence-bound documentary consolidation authority and capabilities
g.text: evidence-bound authority · consumes evidence · may reject incomplete input
documentary consolidation ≠ evidence creation · no Git write

g.aria-label: Conditional authority dependencies without temporal order
g.text: Git write / reserved action → Human Authority

g.aria-label: Non-sequential gate model
Derived visual legends
g.text: AUTHORITY CLASSES · DERIVED VISUAL LEGEND, NOT CONTRACTUAL ENTITIES
COORDINATE · STRUCTURAL DECIDE — SCOPED · DOMAIN RECOMMEND · AUDIT GATE
Authority is bounded by explicit scope; capability never grants authority or permission.

g.aria-label: Derived representation status
g.text: View C is an authority / capability zoom of the Operating Model System. Authority governed by canonical sources.
Exactly seven persistent roles · restrictions and classes are visual translations, not new rules or sources of truth.
